Auditor
The Auditor performs many duties in Montgomery County, working to improve the lives of its people. The Auditor serves as the county's chief fiscal officer, chief assessor, and sealer of weights and measures.
Office of Management and Budget
The hotel/motel tax is a 3% lodging tax administered by the Office of Management and Budget under the authority of the Board of County Commissioners of Montgomery County.
Recorder
The Recorder has the important task of safekeeping the documents pertaining to land ownership and all encumbrances upon it.
Treasurer
The Treasurer is dedicated to providing taxpayers with the very best customer service and assistance.
